summary_zh: Yazi 是一款用 Rust 编写、基于异步 I/O 的终端文件管理器，提供全异步文件操作、多线程任务调度、内置图片与代码预览、Lua 插件系统、虚拟文件系统、多标签与跨目录选择、批量重命名及压缩包解压等功能，并可与 ripgrep、fd、fzf、zoxide、Rclone 等工具集成。
audience_zh: 适合习惯终端操作、需要高效且可定制文件管理体验的用户，尤其是使用 Vim 类操作、需要图片预览或远程文件管理，并愿意接受测试阶段变动的开发者与进阶用户。

evidence.quote: 💥 Blazing fast terminal file manager written in Rust, based on async I/O.
Yazi (means "duck") is a terminal file manager written in Rust, based on non-blocking async I/O. It aims to provide an efficient, user-friendly, and customizable file management experience.
- 💫 Vim-like input/pick/confirm/which/notify component, auto-completion for cd paths
Public beta, can be used as a daily driver.
